cases.input: Only a rate changes for an unchanged commercial shape.
cases.expect: Offering remains; one immutable plan version is added.
Successor Offering is created and predecessor plan remains unchanged.

cases.input: An Offering adds quota for future buyers.
cases.expect: Successor Offering is created; live predecessor agreements are unchanged.

cases.input: Currency, billing period or term length changes.
cases.expect: Successor Offering is created because commercial shape changed.

cases.input: A future rate is published with effectiveFrom.
cases.expect: Historical quote resolution returns the plan version effective at quote time.

cases.input: A change matches no declared class.
cases.expect: Safe default creates a successor Offering and logs the case.

cases.input: A quote and agreement pin Offering, planName and planVersionOrdinal.
cases.expect: Exactly one immutable plan version resolves; no Offering version exists.

cases.input: An accepted quote discounts an agreement.
cases.expect: Agreement still pins Offering plus plan path; entitlement derives only from Offering.

cases.input: A quote attempts to add entitlement absent from Offering.
cases.expect: The quote is rejected and a successor Offering is required.

cases.input: An Offering is withdrawn while agreements remain active.
cases.expect: Orderability ends, but agreements, entitlement and plan pins survive without catalogue-driven migration.

cases.input: A free internal Offering is orderable.
cases.expect: It carries an explicit zero-rate plan; missing plan means not orderable.

cases.input: A bundle Offering nests another Offering and independently bills member plans.
cases.expect: Nested recursion and member billing are rejected.

cases.input: A roadmap item is cancelled after a quote or agreement exists.
cases.expect: Quote and agreement remain unchanged; no catalogue or contract mutation follows.
